text: Two more parts of task 032 landed, on the person's answers of 2026-11-20 (docs/ideas/20261120.md, 'Task 032: two choices, answered'); each needs a template version and a builder change, which are the meta role's. (1) dftmd-12, at cab2e86, 'Held item, shown pending (Recommended)': bundle check B5 now accepts in validation/scientific/ a held item, {held: {reason, needs}}, expected_verdict not_run, call.tool a tool of the bundle, measure naming no reference_function, and prints it PENDING; a held item elsewhere, or without reason or needs, or expected otherwise, or naming a reference function, fails B5. Asked: the template's src/validate_tasks.py reports a held item as not_run with its reason and needs and looks for no reference function, and the builder writes a held item where a comparison cannot be judged yet (qe-h2-bond's and hoomd-h2-bond's sci-1 are the cases) instead of a task naming a reference function no bundle has. (2) dftmd-10, at e678716, 'Compare in its printed unit (Recommended)': where a reference is printed in another unit than the measured quantity, the reference stays as printed and the measured value and the run's own error are converted into its unit through the registry by unit_convert@v1, and the standing rule runs there; validation_report's scientific task may now state reference.unit and measured {value, unit, converted_from {value, unit}, converted_by}, and check 12 recomputes that conversion by the registry's factor and asks that the measured value, a rule-derived tolerance and the agreement be in reference.unit. Asked: validate_tasks.py and the way tolerance_from_reference is fed do this conversion and write those fields, shown on two kinds (contracts/tests/test_check12.py uses a DFT rest length against angstrom and a viscosity against mPa.s). Task 032 is marked done once meta_agent/tests passes again with the --ran-by calls of note 20261120-design-macbook-20261120-2-4.
